title: Sequential operator learning under dependent data
abstract: arXiv:2608.24426v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Learning operators from sequentially collected data arises in adaptive experimental design, Bayesian optimization, and dynamical-system modelling, where observations may be dependent, and future inputs or sensing operators may depend on preceding data. We derive time-uniform self-normalized concentration bounds for stochastic processes in Hilbert spaces with vector-valued noise. We use these bounds to obtain regression-error guarantees for linear operators, including targets outside the Hilbert estimation space, and for nonlinear parametric operators trained with strongly convex losses and regularizers. Our results allow possibly infinite-dimensional inputs and outputs without independence or mixing assumptions, providing a major step towards convergence guarantees for adaptive operator learning and learning from stochastic dynamical data.

translated_title: 依赖数据下的序列算子学习
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.24426v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从顺序收集的数据中学习算子出现在自适应实验设计、贝叶斯优化和动力系统建模中，在这些场景中，观测可能是依赖的，且未来的输入或传感算子可能依赖于先前数据。我们推导了在具有向量值噪声的希尔伯特空间中随机过程的时间一致自归一化浓度界。我们利用这些界获得了线性算子的回归误差保证，包括估计空间外的目标，以及使用强凸损失和正则化器训练的非线性参数算子。我们的结果允许可能无限维的输入和输出，无需独立性或混合假设，这为自适应算子学习和从随机动力学数据中学习的收敛性保证迈出了重要一步。
tldr: 本文提出了在依赖数据下用于算子学习的时间一致自归一化浓度界，无需独立性或混合假设，为自适应和动力学数据驱动的算子学习提供了收敛性保证。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces time-uniform self-normalized concentration bounds for operator learning under dependent data without independence or mixing assumptions, offering convergence guarantees for adaptive and dynamical-data-driven operator learning.
